summary: A mixing console for up to 16 machine connections: each strip's Volume and Pan set that connection's amp and pan, as the machine view's sliders do.
use_for: Balance the levels and pans of many machine connections from one console.
quirks: A strip does nothing until a connection is assigned to it in the machine's window (the assignment is saved state, not a parameter); an unassigned strip's Volume and Pan are ignored.
Volume is 0 to 400 percent of the connection's level (raw 16,384 is 100 percent, the default); Pan is -100 to +100 percent (raw 16,384 is the centre).
connection_set sets a connection's amp and pan directly and is the simpler route from here.
It makes no sound itself; MIDI controllers can be bound to its strips in its window.
evidence: Machines/ConnectionMixer/ConnectionMixer.cs — the machine's source: its declarations, Work and menu
ReBuzz/Core/MachineConnectionCore.cs — the connection's Amp and Pan that the strips write

parameters.name: Vol1
parameters.how: Sets the volume of the connection assigned to strip 1, 0 to 400 percent of the connection's own level (100 percent is unity, raw 16,384, the default).
parameters.sound: Raises or lowers how loud that one connection is in its destination, as the machine view's connection slider does; above 100 percent it can overload the destination.

parameters.name: Pan1
parameters.how: Pans the connection assigned to strip 1 from -100 percent (left) through 0 (centre, raw 16,384, the default) to +100 percent (right).
parameters.sound: Places that one connection in the stereo field of its destination, as the machine view's pan slider does.
